newsitem.title: UK: EMS/Lira a touch firmer after Italy rate cut.
newsitem.headline: EMS/Lira a touch firmer after Italy rate cut.

text.p: 0655 GMT - Lira a touch firmer vs mark after Italy cuts key rates late Friday, other mark crosses make steady start.
* Italy cuts discount and Lombard rates by 50 bps to 6.25 pct and 7.75 pct respectively. Mark/lira at 976.20/50 vs 977.40/60 in Friday trade before rate cut.

* Italy treasury minister Ciampi says rate cut brings Italy EMU membership closer, sees continues trend for lower rates. But Ciampi also warns against over-optimism over membership, saying Italy has long way to go.
* Bundesbank's Tietmeyer says sustainable budget discipline more important than hitting targets, sees no reason to change current monetary policy.
* German finmin Waigel says France still wants to cut budget deficit, after French finmin Strauss-Kahn says Thursday that France will probably exceed three-pct deficit/GDP target.
* Mark/Paris 3.3724/27 vs Friday's 3.3727/30, mark/peseta at 84.48/50 vs 84.51/53.
